tier_meaning.gold: three or more independent lineages agreed
tier_meaning.reference: one lineage only (PROJ); catches plumbing errors, does not establish correctness

note: expected values are a consensus across engines, not a recording of any one engine; compare with tolerance_m, never for equality

field_meaning.coordinate_epoch: the epoch to supply with the source coordinates; required to reproduce any record that carries it
field_meaning.source_frame_epoch: reference epoch of the source dynamic frame, descriptive only; using it as the coordinate epoch moves the answer by up to a metre

horizontal_conversion.jsonl.description: Same datum; projection and unit maths only.

horizontal_datum_shift.jsonl.description: Datum change by analytic method (Helmert, Molodensky-Badekas).

horizontal_grid.jsonl.description: Datum change that consumed a PROJ grid file. Requires those grids.

dynamic.jsonl.description: Epoch-dependent; source or target is a dynamic reference frame.
